modern: Is my understanding sufficient for this or not? If it is sufficient, I use it for the work as an instrument given by the universal nature. But if it is not sufficient, then either I withdraw from the work and give way to someone who can do it better, unless there is some reason why I ought not to do so; or I do it as well as I can, taking to help me the man who, with the aid of my ruling principle, can do what is now fitting and useful for the general good. For whatever I can do, either by myself or with another, ought to be directed to this alone: to what is useful and well suited to society.

explained.summary:
Ask honestly whether you’re up to the task. If you are, get on with it, treating your mind as a tool nature gave you for the job. If you aren’t, either hand it to someone better suited, unless duty says otherwise, or do your best with the help of someone who can fill the gap.

What matters is not who gets the credit but that the work serves the common good.
explained.today: A manager who knows a project is beyond their expertise can pass it to a colleague who knows it better, or bring that person in alongside, instead of struggling on out of pride. The same goes for a parent asking for help with homework they can’t follow.
